records.literal_gloss: And the house which I [am] building [will be] great, for great [is] our God above all the gods.

en.L: And the house that I am building [will be] great, for our God [is] great above all the gods.
en.B: The house I am building will be great, because our God is great above all gods.
en.R: The temple I am going to build will be great, since our God is far above every other god.

es.L: Y la casa que yo edifico [será] grande, porque nuestro Dios [es] grande sobre todos los dioses.
es.B: La casa que voy a edificar será grande, porque nuestro Dios es más grande que todos los dioses.
es.R: El templo que voy a construir será grande, porque nuestro Dios está muy por encima de todos los demás dioses.

fr.L: Et la maison que je bâtis [sera] grande, car notre Dieu [est] grand au-dessus de tous les dieux.
fr.B: La maison que je vais bâtir sera grande, car notre Dieu est plus grand que tous les dieux.
fr.R: Le temple que je vais construire sera grand, parce que notre Dieu est bien au-dessus de tous les autres dieux.

sw.L: Na nyumba ninayoijenga [itakuwa] kubwa, kwa maana Mungu wetu [ni] mkuu kuliko miungu yote.
sw.B: Nyumba ninayoijenga itakuwa kubwa, kwa sababu Mungu wetu ni mkuu kuliko miungu yote.
sw.R: Hekalu nitakalojenga litakuwa kubwa, kwa kuwa Mungu wetu yu juu sana kuliko miungu mingine yote.

vi.L: Nhà mà tôi đang xây [sẽ] lớn, vì Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi lớn hơn mọi thần.
vi.B: Nhà tôi sắp xây sẽ lớn, vì Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi vĩ đại hơn mọi thần.
vi.R: Đền thờ tôi sắp xây sẽ rất lớn, vì Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi cao trọng hơn hết mọi thần khác.

ko.L: 그리고 제가 짓는 집은 클 것입니다. 우리 하나님께서는 모든 신보다 크시기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 제가 지으려는 집은 클 것입니다. 우리 하나님께서는 모든 신보다 위대하시기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 제가 지으려는 성전은 크고 웅장할 것입니다. 우리 하나님께서는 다른 어떤 신보다 훨씬 위대하시기 때문입니다.

pt.L: E a casa que eu estou construindo [será] grande, porque o nosso Deus [é] grande, acima de todos os deuses.
pt.B: A casa que estou construindo será grande, porque o nosso Deus é grande, acima de todos os deuses.
pt.R: O templo que vou construir será grande, pois o nosso Deus está muito acima de qualquer outro deus.

am.L: የምሠራውም ቤት ታላቅ [ይሆናል]፤ አምላካችን ከአማልክት ሁሉ በላይ ታላቅ ነውና።
am.B: የምሠራው ቤት ታላቅ ይሆናል፤ አምላካችን ከአማልክት ሁሉ በላይ ታላቅ ነውና።
am.R: የምሠራው ቤተ መቅደስ ታላቅ ይሆናል፤ አምላካችን ከሌሎች አማልክት ሁሉ እጅግ በላይ ነውና።

hi.L: और जो भवन मैं बना रहा हूँ वह बड़ा [होगा], क्योंकि हमारे परमेश्वर सब देवताओं से बड़े [हैं]।
hi.B: जो भवन मैं बनाने जा रहा हूँ वह बड़ा होगा, क्योंकि हमारे परमेश्वर सब देवताओं से बड़े हैं।
hi.R: जो भवन मैं बनाने जा रहा हूँ वह बड़ा होगा, क्योंकि हमारे परमेश्वर हर दूसरे देवता से कहीं बढ़कर हैं।

ru.L: И дом, который я строю, [будет] велик, потому что велик наш Бог превыше всех богов.
ru.B: Дом, который я строю, будет великим, потому что наш Бог велик, превыше всех богов.
ru.R: Храм, который я построю, будет большим, потому что наш Бог намного выше всех других богов.

ja.L: そして、わたしが建てる家は大いなるもの[となります]。わたしたちの神は、すべての神々にまさって大いなる方だからです。
ja.B: わたしが建てる家は大きなものです。わたしたちの神は、すべての神々にまさって偉大な方だからです。
ja.R: わたしが建てる神殿は、大きくてりっぱなものになります。わたしたちの神は、ほかのどんな神々よりも、はるかに偉大な方だからです。

uk.L: І дім, який я будую, [буде] великий, бо наш Бог [є] великий понад усіх богів.
uk.B: Дім, який я будую, буде великий, бо наш Бог великий понад усіх богів.
uk.R: Храм, який я збудую, буде великий, бо наш Бог набагато вищий за всіх інших богів.

decisions.choice: great above all the gods: Yahweh is supreme over the gods of the nations
decisions.reason: Solomon writes to a king who served other gods, and says plainly that his God is above them all (Exodus 18:11; Psalm 95:3). The greatness of the house is to fit the greatness of the God it honors.

decisions.choice: great ... great: the same word twice
decisions.reason: The house will be great because God is great; the repeated word ties the two together. The second is a comparison, "great beyond" or "greater than" all gods.

decisions.choice: far above every other god (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable puts the comparison (m2) in plain words.

source.text: וּמִ֤י יַעֲצָר־כֹּ֨חַ֙ לִבְנֽוֹת־ל֣וֹ בַ֔יִת כִּ֧י הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וּשְׁמֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א יְכַלְכְּלֻ֑הוּ וּמִ֤י אֲנִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶבְנֶה־לּ֣וֹ בַ֔יִת כִּ֖י אִם־לְהַקְטִ֥יר לְפָנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: But who retains strength to build for him a house, for the heavens and [the] heavens of the heavens not contain him? And who [am] I that I should build for him a house, except to burn [offerings] before him?

en.L: But who is able to build {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a house, since the heavens and the heavens of the heavens cannot contain {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}? And who [am] I that I should build {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a house, except to burn [offerings] before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.B: But who is able to build a house for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, when heaven itself, even the highest heaven, cannot contain {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}? Who am I, then, to build {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a house, except as a place to burn offerings before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?
en.R: But no one can really build a house for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Even the sky and the highest heaven cannot hold {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! So who am I to build a temple for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}? It can only be a place where offerings are burned to honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Pero ¿quién tendrá fuerzas para edificarle casa, si los cielos y los cielos de los cielos no lo pueden contener? ¿Y quién [soy] yo para edificarle casa, sino para quemar [ofrendas] delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}?
es.B: Pero ¿quién es capaz de edificarle una casa, cuando el cielo, y aun el más alto de los cielos, no lo puede contener? ¿Quién soy yo, entonces, para edificarle una casa, si no es como un lugar donde quemar ofrendas delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}?
es.R: Pero nadie puede de verdad construirle una casa. ¡Ni siquiera el cielo, ni el más alto de los cielos, puede contenerlo! Entonces, ¿quién soy yo para construirle un templo? Solo puede ser un lugar donde se quemen ofrendas en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} honor.

fr.L: Mais qui aurait la force de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} bâtir une maison, puisque les cieux et les cieux des cieux ne peuvent {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} contenir ? Et qui [suis]-je pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} bâtir une maison, sinon pour brûler [des offrandes] devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ?
fr.B: Mais qui serait capable de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} bâtir une maison, alors que le ciel, et même le plus haut des cieux, ne peut {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} contenir ? Qui suis-je donc pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} bâtir une maison, sinon comme un lieu où brûler des offrandes devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ?
fr.R: Mais personne ne peut vraiment {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} construire une maison. Même le ciel et le plus haut des cieux ne peuvent pas {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} contenir ! Alors qui suis-je pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} construire un temple ? Ce ne peut être qu’un lieu où l’on brûle des offrandes pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorer.

sw.L: Lakini ni nani awezaye kumjengea nyumba, kwa kuwa mbingu na mbingu za mbingu haziwezi kumtosha? Nami ni nani hata nimjengee nyumba, isipokuwa ili kufukiza [sadaka] mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?
sw.B: Lakini ni nani awezaye kumjengea nyumba, wakati mbingu zenyewe, hata mbingu za juu kabisa, haziwezi kumtosha? Basi mimi ni nani nimjengee nyumba, isipokuwa iwe mahali pa kufukiza sadaka mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?
sw.R: Lakini hakuna mtu anayeweza kweli kumjengea nyumba. Hata anga na mbingu za juu kabisa haziwezi kumtosha! Basi mimi ni nani hata nimjengee hekalu? Litakuwa tu mahali pa kuteketeza sadaka kwa heshima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Nhưng ai có sức xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một cái nhà, vì các tầng trời và trời của các tầng trời cũng không chứa nổi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Và tôi [là] ai mà xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một cái nhà, ngoại trừ để đốt [lễ vật] trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.B: Nhưng ai có thể xây một cái nhà cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, khi chính các tầng trời, ngay cả trời cao nhất, cũng không chứa nổi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Vậy tôi là ai mà xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một cái nhà, ngoại trừ làm nơi đốt lễ vật trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.R: Nhưng thật ra không ai có thể xây nhà cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được. Ngay cả bầu trời và trời cao nhất cũng không chứa nổi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Vậy tôi là ai mà xây đền thờ cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Đền thờ ấy chỉ có thể là nơi để dâng lễ vật thiêu tôn vinh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러나 누가 그분을 위하여 집을 지을 힘이 있겠습니까? 하늘과 하늘들의 하늘도 그분을 담지 못하는데 말입니다. 그러니 제가 누구이기에 그분을 위하여 집을 짓겠습니까? 다만 그분 앞에서 [제물을] 태우려는 것일 뿐입니다.
ko.B: 그러나 하늘도, 가장 높은 하늘도 그분을 담을 수 없는데, 누가 그분을 위하여 집을 지을 수 있겠습니까? 그러니 제가 누구이기에 그분께 집을 지어 드리겠습니까? 다만 그분 앞에서 제물을 태워 드릴 곳을 마련하려는 것뿐입니다.
ko.R: 그러나 사실 아무도 그분이 사실 집을 지어 드릴 수 없습니다. 하늘도, 가장 높은 하늘도 그분을 다 담을 수 없기 때문입니다. 그러니 제가 무엇이기에 그분께 성전을 지어 드리겠습니까? 그곳은 다만 그분을 높이며 제물을 태워 바치는 곳일 뿐입니다.

pt.L: Mas quem tem força para construir para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} uma casa, se os céus e os céus dos céus não {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} podem conter? E quem [sou] eu para construir para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} uma casa, a não ser para queimar [ofertas] diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}?
pt.B: Mas quem é capaz de construir uma casa para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, se nem os céus, nem mesmo os céus dos céus, {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} podem conter? Quem sou eu, então, para construir uma casa para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, a não ser como um lugar para queimar ofertas diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}?
pt.R: Mas ninguém pode de fato construir uma casa para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Nem o céu, nem o mais alto dos céus pode {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} conter! Então quem sou eu para construir um templo para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}? Esse templo só pode ser um lugar onde se queimam ofertas para honrá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.

am.L: ነገር ግን ሰማያትና የሰማያት ሰማያት ሊይዙት ካልቻሉ ለእርሱ ቤት ሊሠራ ኃይል ያለው ማን ነው? እኔስ በፊቱ [መሥዋዕት] ከማጠን በቀር ለእርሱ ቤት የምሠራ ማን ነኝ?
am.B: ነገር ግን ሰማይ፣ ከፍተኛው ሰማይ እንኳ ሊይዘው ካልቻለ ለእርሱ ቤት ሊሠራ የሚችል ማን ነው? ታዲያ በፊቱ መሥዋዕት የሚቃጠልበት ስፍራ ከመሥራት በቀር ለእርሱ ቤት የምሠራ እኔ ማን ነኝ?
am.R: ነገር ግን ማንም ሰው በእውነት ለእርሱ ቤት ሊሠራ አይችልም። ሰማይና ከሰማያት በላይ ያለው ሰማይ እንኳ ሊይዘው አይችልም! ታዲያ ለእርሱ ቤተ መቅደስ የምሠራ እኔ ማን ነኝ? ቤቱ እርሱን ለማክበር መሥዋዕት የሚቃጠልበት ስፍራ ብቻ ሊሆን ይችላል።

hi.L: पर कौन इतना सामर्थ्य रखता है कि उनके लिए भवन बनाए, जब कि स्वर्ग और स्वर्गों का स्वर्ग भी उन्हें समा नहीं सकते? और मैं कौन [हूँ] कि उनके लिए भवन बनाऊँ, केवल उनके सामने [बलि] जलाने के लिए ही?
hi.B: पर कौन उनके लिए भवन बना सकता है, जब स्वर्ग, बल्कि सबसे ऊँचा स्वर्ग भी उन्हें समा नहीं सकता? फिर मैं कौन हूँ कि उनके लिए भवन बनाऊँ, सिवाय इसके कि वह उनके सामने बलि जलाने का स्थान हो?
hi.R: पर सच में कोई भी उनके लिए भवन नहीं बना सकता। आकाश और सबसे ऊँचा स्वर्ग भी उन्हें समा नहीं सकता! तो मैं कौन हूँ कि उनके लिए भवन बनाऊँ? वह केवल एक ऐसा स्थान हो सकता है जहाँ उनके आदर में बलियाँ जलाई जाएँ।

ru.L: Но кто имеет силу построить {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} дом, если небеса и небеса небес не вмещают {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}? И кто я, чтобы построить {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} дом, разве только чтобы воскурять [жертвы] перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}?
ru.B: Но кто способен построить для {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}} дом, когда само небо, даже высшие небеса, не могут вместить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}? Кто же я такой, чтобы строить {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} дом, разве только как место, где сжигают жертвы перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}?
ru.R: Но никто не может по-настоящему построить {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} дом. Даже небо и самые высокие небеса не могут вместить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}! Так кто я такой, чтобы строить {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} храм? Это может быть только место, где сжигают жертвы в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} честь.

ja.L: しかし、だれがその方のために家を建てる力を保てるでしょうか？天も、天の天も、その方をお入れすることができないのです。そして、わたしが何者であって、その方の前で[ささげ物を]焼くため以外に、その方のために家を建てられるでしょうか？
ja.B: しかし、だれがその方のために家を建てることができるでしょうか？天も、天の天さえも、その方をお入れすることはできないのです。それなら、わたしが何者だというので、その方の前でささげ物を焼く場所として以外に、その方のための家を建てられるでしょうか？
ja.R: けれども、本当にその方のための家を建てることは、だれにもできません。天も、いちばん高い天でさえも、その方をお入れすることはできないのです！それなのに、その方のための神殿を建てるとは、わたしはいったい何者なのでしょうか？それは、その方をあがめて、ささげ物を焼くための場所にすぎません。

uk.L: Але хто здатен збудувати {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} дім, коли небеса і небеса небес не можуть умістити {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}? І хто я, щоб збудувати {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} дім, хіба тільки щоб кадити перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}?
uk.B: Але хто здатен збудувати дім для {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}, коли навіть небо, навіть найвище небо, не може {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} вмістити? Хто ж я такий, щоб збудувати {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} дім, хіба що як місце, де спалюють жертви перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}?
uk.R: Але ніхто не може справді збудувати дім для {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}. Навіть небо й найвище небо не можуть {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} вмістити! Тож хто я такий, щоб збудувати {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} храм? Він може бути лише місцем, де спалюють жертви на {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} честь.

decisions.choice: who retains strength: who is able
decisions.reason: To "retain strength" is to have the power to do something (1 Chronicles 29:14). The question expects the answer "no one".

decisions.choice: the heavens cannot contain him: Solomon's prayer at the dedication
decisions.reason: Solomon says the same at the dedication of the house: "the heavens and the heavens of the heavens cannot contain you" (1 Kings 8:27; 2 Chronicles 6:18). Here he says it before the building begins.

decisions.choice: the heavens of the heavens: the highest heaven
decisions.reason: The phrase means the heavens at their utmost, the whole of the heavens and beyond (Deuteronomy 10:14).

decisions.choice: to burn before him: a place for offerings, not a dwelling that holds God
alternatives: except to burn incense before him
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up in smoke, used for incense and for offerings burned on the altar. Solomon sees the house not as a home that holds God but as a place where Israel worships him. In verse 3 the same verb has incense as its object, and incense alone may be meant here.

decisions.choice: as a place to burn offerings (Balanced); a place where offerings are burned to honor him (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "a place" and "offerings" to say what the house is for (m4).

decisions.choice: statements for the first question (Readable)
decisions.reason: The first question means "no one can" (m1), and Readable says that directly; it keeps the second question, which Solomon asks of himself.

decisions.choice: "los cielos de los cielos" (L); "el más alto de los cielos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The phrase means the highest heaven (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Hebrew form and Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "제물을 태워 드릴 곳을 마련하려는 것" (B); "제물을 태워 바치는 곳" (R)
decisions.reason: The house is a place for offerings, not a dwelling that holds God (m4), as the English Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: os céus e os céus dos céus (L, B); nem o céu, nem o mais alto dos céus (R)
alternatives: o céu e o céu dos céus
decisions.reason: Solomon says here what he will say at the dedication (m2), so the phrase takes the words of 1 Kings 8:27 in Portuguese at each level, for 6:18 to repeat.

decisions.choice: "небеса и небеса небес" (L); "небо, даже высшие небеса" (B); "небо и самые высокие небеса" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew superlative; Balanced and Readable say what it means (m3), as Solomon's prayer will in 6:18.

decisions.choice: God is "その方" throughout Solomon's letter, never 彼; the heavens cannot "お入れする" him.
decisions.reason: Style guide §4.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֡ה שְֽׁלַֽח־לִ֣י אִישׁ־חָכָ֡ם לַעֲשׂוֹת֩ בַּזָּהָ֨ב וּבַכֶּ֜סֶף וּבַנְּחֹ֣שֶׁת וּבַבַּרְזֶ֗ל וּבָֽאַרְגְּוָן֙ וְכַרְמִ֣יל וּתְכֵ֔לֶת וְיֹדֵ֖עַ לְפַתֵּ֣חַ פִּתּוּחִ֑ים עִם־הַֽחֲכָמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר עִמִּי֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֣ה וּבִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵכִ֖ין דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And now send to me a man skilled to work in gold and in silver and in bronze and in iron and in purple and crimson and violet, and knowing to engrave engravings, with the skilled [ones] who [are] with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom provided David my father.

en.L: And now send me a man skilled to work in gold and in silver and in bronze and in iron, and in purple and crimson and blue [yarn], and who knows how to engrave engravings, [to work] with the skilled men who [are] with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.
en.B: So now send me a man skilled in working with gold, silver, bronze and iron, and with purple, crimson and blue yarn, who also knows how to engrave. He will work with the skilled craftsmen I have here in Judah and Jerusalem, whom my father David provided.
en.R: So please send me a skilled craftsman. He must know how to work with gold, silver, bronze and iron, and with purple, red and blue cloth, and how to carve designs. He will work with the skilled workers my father David arranged for me here in Judah and Jerusalem.

es.L: Y ahora envíame un hombre hábil para trabajar en oro y en plata y en bronce y en hierro, y en púrpura y carmesí y azul, y que sepa grabar grabados, [para trabajar] con los hábiles que [están] conmigo en Judá y en Jerusalén, los que preparó David mi padre.
es.B: Así que ahora envíame un hombre experto en trabajar el oro, la plata, el bronce y el hierro, y la lana de púrpura, carmesí y azul, que sepa también grabar. Trabajará con los artesanos expertos que tengo aquí en Judá y en Jerusalén, los que mi padre David proveyó.
es.R: Así que te ruego que me envíes un artesano muy hábil. Debe saber trabajar el oro, la plata, el bronce y el hierro, y las telas de color púrpura, rojo y azul, y debe saber tallar adornos. Trabajará con los artesanos hábiles que mi padre David preparó para mí aquí en Judá y en Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et maintenant, envoie-moi un homme habile à travailler l’or, et l’argent, et le bronze, et le fer, et la pourpre, et le cramoisi, et le [fil] bleu, et qui sache graver des gravures, [pour travailler] avec les hommes habiles qui [sont] avec moi en Juda et à Jérusalem, que David mon père a procurés.
fr.B: Envoie-moi donc maintenant un homme habile à travailler l’or, l’argent, le bronze et le fer, ainsi que le fil pourpre, cramoisi et bleu, et qui sache aussi graver. Il travaillera avec les artisans habiles que j’ai ici en Juda et à Jérusalem, et que mon père David a procurés.
fr.R: Alors s’il te plaît, envoie-moi un artisan habile. Il doit savoir travailler l’or, l’argent, le bronze et le fer, les tissus pourpres, rouges et bleus, et savoir sculpter des motifs. Il travaillera avec les ouvriers habiles que mon père David a réunis pour moi ici, en Juda et à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Basi sasa nitumie mtu stadi wa kufanya kazi ya dhahabu na ya fedha na ya shaba na ya chuma, na ya [uzi wa] zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu na wa samawati, ajuaye kuchora michoro, [afanye kazi] pamoja na mafundi stadi walio pamoja nami katika Yuda na katika Yerusalemu, aliowaweka Daudi baba yangu.
sw.B: Basi sasa nitumie mtu stadi wa kufanya kazi ya dhahabu, fedha, shaba na chuma, na ya uzi wa zambarau, mwekundu na wa samawati, ambaye pia anajua kuchora nakshi. Atafanya kazi pamoja na mafundi stadi nilio nao hapa Yuda na Yerusalemu, ambao baba yangu Daudi aliwaweka tayari.
sw.R: Basi tafadhali nitumie fundi stadi. Ni lazima ajue kufanya kazi ya dhahabu, fedha, shaba na chuma, na ya vitambaa vya zambarau, vyekundu na vya samawati, na kuchora nakshi. Atafanya kazi pamoja na mafundi stadi ambao baba yangu Daudi aliniandalia hapa Yuda na Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ xin gửi cho tôi một người khéo léo làm [đồ] bằng vàng, bằng bạc, bằng đồng và bằng sắt, và bằng [chỉ] màu tía, đỏ thẫm và xanh dương, và biết chạm trổ các hình chạm, [để làm việc] với những người khéo léo đang ở với tôi tại Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem, là những người Đa-vít cha tôi đã chuẩn bị.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ xin ông gửi cho tôi một người khéo léo làm đồ bằng vàng, bạc, đồng và sắt, cùng với chỉ màu tía, đỏ thẫm và xanh dương, lại biết chạm trổ. Người ấy sẽ làm việc với các thợ khéo tôi có ở Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem, là những người Đa-vít cha tôi đã chuẩn bị.
vi.R: Vậy xin ông gửi cho tôi một người thợ giỏi. Người ấy phải biết làm đồ bằng vàng, bạc, đồng và sắt, biết làm với vải màu tía, đỏ và xanh dương, và biết chạm trổ hoa văn. Người ấy sẽ làm việc với những thợ giỏi mà Đa-vít cha tôi đã sắp đặt cho tôi ở Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그러니 이제 금과 은과 놋과 쇠와 자주색 실과 진홍색 실과 청색 실로 일하는 데 능숙하고, 새기는 일을 할 줄 아는 사람을 제게 보내 주십시오. [그가] 제 아버지 다윗이 마련해 둔, 유다와 예루살렘에서 저와 함께 있는 숙련된 사람들과 함께 [일할 것입니다].
ko.B: 그러니 이제 금과 은과 놋과 쇠를 다루고, 자주색과 진홍색과 청색 실을 다루는 데 능숙하며, 새기는 일도 할 줄 아는 사람을 한 사람 보내 주십시오. 그는 제 아버지 다윗이 마련해 둔, 유다와 예루살렘에 있는 제 숙련된 기술자들과 함께 일할 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러니 솜씨 좋은 기술자를 한 사람 보내 주십시오. 그 사람은 금과 은과 놋과 쇠를 다룰 줄 알고, 자주색, 붉은색, 파란색 천을 다룰 줄 알고, 무늬를 새길 줄 알아야 합니다. 그는 제 아버지 다윗이 마련해 둔 유다와 예루살렘의 솜씨 좋은 일꾼들과 함께 일할 것입니다.

pt.L: E agora envie-me um homem hábil para trabalhar em ouro, e em prata, e em bronze, e em ferro, e em [fio] roxo, e carmesim, e azul, e que saiba gravar gravuras, [para trabalhar] com os homens hábeis que [estão] comigo em Judá e em Jerusalém, os quais Davi, meu pai, providenciou.
pt.B: Envie-me, então, um homem hábil em trabalhar com ouro, prata, bronze e ferro, e com fios roxo, carmesim e azul, e que saiba também fazer gravuras. Ele trabalhará com os artesãos hábeis que tenho aqui em Judá e em Jerusalém, que o meu pai Davi providenciou.
pt.R: Por isso, por favor, mande-me um artesão habilidoso. Ele precisa saber trabalhar com ouro, prata, bronze e ferro, e com tecidos roxos, vermelhos e azuis, e saber entalhar desenhos. Ele vai trabalhar com os trabalhadores habilidosos que o meu pai Davi arranjou para mim aqui em Judá e em Jerusalém.

am.L: አሁንም በወርቅና በብር፣ በነሐስና በብረት፣ በሐምራዊና በቀይ በሰማያዊም [ፈትል] ለመሥራት ጥበበኛ የሆነውን፣ ቅርጽንም መቅረጽ የሚያውቅ ሰው ላክልኝ፤ አባቴ ዳዊት ካዘጋጃቸው በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ከእኔ ጋር ካሉት ጥበበኞች ጋር [ይሠራ ዘንድ]።
am.B: ስለዚህ አሁን በወርቅ፣ በብር፣ በነሐስና በብረት እንዲሁም በሐምራዊ፣ በቀይና በሰማያዊ ፈትል የመሥራት ጥበብ ያለውን፣ ቅርጽም መቅረጽ የሚያውቅ ሰው ላክልኝ። እርሱም አባቴ ዳዊት ካዘጋጃቸው በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ከእኔ ጋር ካሉት ጥበበኛ ባለሙያዎች ጋር ይሠራል።
am.R: ስለዚህ እባክህ አንድ ጥበበኛ ባለሙያ ላክልኝ። ወርቅን፣ ብርን፣ ነሐስንና ብረትን፣ ሐምራዊ፣ ቀይና ሰማያዊ ጨርቅንም እንዴት እንደሚሠራ፣ ቅርጽም እንዴት እንደሚቀረጽ የሚያውቅ መሆን አለበት። እርሱም አባቴ ዳዊት ለእኔ ካዘጋጃቸው በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ካሉት ጥበበኛ ሠራተኞች ጋር ይሠራል።

hi.L: और अब मेरे पास एक ऐसा कुशल पुरुष भेजिए जो सोने और चाँदी और पीतल और लोहे में, और बैंगनी और लाल और नीले [धागे] में काम करना जानता हो, और नक़्क़ाशी करना जानता हो, [कि वह] उन कुशल पुरुषों के साथ [काम करे] जो यहूदा और यरूशलेम में मेरे पास [हैं], जिन्हें मेरे पिता दाऊद ने ठहराया था।
hi.B: इसलिए अब मेरे पास एक ऐसा कुशल पुरुष भेजिए जो सोने, चाँदी, पीतल और लोहे का, और बैंगनी, लाल और नीले धागे का काम जानता हो, और नक़्क़ाशी भी कर सकता हो। वह उन कुशल कारीगरों के साथ काम करेगा जो यहूदा और यरूशलेम में मेरे पास हैं, जिन्हें मेरे पिता दाऊद ने ठहराया था।
hi.R: इसलिए कृपया मेरे पास एक कुशल कारीगर भेजिए। उसे सोने, चाँदी, पीतल और लोहे का, और बैंगनी, लाल और नीले कपड़े का काम आना चाहिए, और नक़्क़ाशी करना भी। वह उन कुशल कारीगरों के साथ काम करेगा जिनका प्रबंध मेरे पिता दाऊद ने यहाँ यहूदा और यरूशलेम में मेरे लिए किया था।

ru.L: И теперь пошли мне человека, искусного в работе с золотом, и с серебром, и с медью, и с железом, и с пурпурной, и багряной, и голубой [пряжей], и умеющего вырезать резьбу, [чтобы работать] с искусными людьми, которые у меня в Иудее и в Иерусалиме, которых приготовил Давид, мой отец.
ru.B: Итак, пошли мне человека, искусного в работе с золотом, серебром, медью и железом, с пурпурной, багряной и голубой пряжей, который умеет также вырезать резьбу. Он будет работать с искусными мастерами, которые есть у меня в Иудее и в Иерусалиме и которых приготовил мой отец Давид.
ru.R: Пожалуйста, пришли мне искусного мастера. Он должен уметь работать с золотом, серебром, медью и железом, с пурпурной, красной и голубой тканью, и уметь вырезать узоры. Он будет работать вместе с искусными мастерами, которых мой отец Давид собрал для меня здесь, в Иудее и Иерусалиме.

ja.L: そして今、金、銀、青銅、鉄、また紫色、深紅色、青色の[糸]の細工に熟練し、彫り物を彫ることを知っている人を、わたしに送ってください。わたしの父ダビデが備えた、ユダとエルサレムでわたしと共にいる熟練した者たちと[共に働くためです]。
ja.B: ですから今、金、銀、青銅、鉄の細工と、紫、深紅、青の糸の細工に熟練し、彫刻もできる人を、わたしに送ってください。その人は、わたしの父ダビデが用意した、ユダとエルサレムにいるわたしの熟練した職人たちと共に働きます。
ja.R: どうか、腕のよい職人を一人送ってください。金、銀、青銅、鉄の細工ができて、紫や赤や青の布も扱うことができ、模様を彫ることもできる人です。その人には、わたしの父ダビデが、ユダとエルサレムでわたしのために用意してくれた腕のよい職人たちと一緒に働いてもらいます。

uk.L: А тепер пошли мені вмілого чоловіка, щоб працювати із золотом, і зі сріблом, і з міддю, і з залізом, і з пурпуровою, і кармазиновою, і блакитною [вовною], і який уміє вирізьблювати різьби, [щоб працював] з умілими людьми, що [є] зі мною в Юді й в Єрусалимі, яких приготував Давид, мій батько.
uk.B: Тож тепер пошли мені чоловіка, вмілого в праці із золотом, сріблом, міддю й залізом і з пурпуровою, кармазиновою й блакитною вовною, який також уміє вирізьблювати. Він працюватиме з умілими майстрами, що є в мене тут, у Юді та в Єрусалимі, яких приготував мій батько Давид.
uk.R: Тож, прошу, пошли мені вмілого майстра. Він мусить уміти працювати із золотом, сріблом, міддю й залізом, з пурпуровою, червоною й блакитною тканиною і вміти вирізьблювати візерунки. Він працюватиме з умілими робітниками, яких мій батько Давид приготував для мене тут, у Юді та в Єрусалимі.

decisions.choice: purple, crimson and blue: costly dyed yarns
decisions.reason: These are the rich colored threads used for the curtains and garments of the sanctuary (Exodus 26:1; 28:5). The word for crimson is found only in Chronicles (here, verse 13 and 3:14) and names a deep red dye; the tabernacle passages use another word for scarlet. The word for purple is a later spelling of the one in Exodus.

decisions.choice: engrave engravings: carving designs
decisions.reason: The verb and noun are used for engraving stones and metal plates (Exodus 28:9-11, 36) and for carving wood (1 Kings 6:29).

decisions.choice: the skilled men David provided
decisions.reason: David had gathered masons, carpenters and craftsmen of every kind for the temple before he died (1 Chronicles 22:15-16; 28:21).

decisions.choice: skilled: wise in a craft
decisions.reason: The word usually rendered "wise" is used of skill in a craft, as of the craftsmen of the tabernacle (Exodus 31:6; 35:10).

decisions.choice: yarn (Literal in brackets, Balanced); cloth, red (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names only the colors; the materials were dyed yarn and the cloth woven from it (m1). Readable says "red" for crimson.

decisions.choice: "la lana de púrpura, carmesí y azul" (B); "las telas de color púrpura, rojo y azul" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): the colors are dyed yarns, named at Balanced and made cloth at Readable.

decisions.choice: "le [fil] bleu" (L), "le fil pourpre, cramoisi et bleu" (B), "les tissus pourpres, rouges et bleus" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names only the colors (m1). French supplies "fil" (yarn) and says "bleu", as the French Pentateuch does for the tabernacle hangings (Exodus 26:31); "cramoisi" keeps this later word for crimson apart from the Pentateuch's "écarlate". Readable says "tissus" and "rouges", as the English Readable says "cloth" and "red".

decisions.choice: zambarau, nyekundu, samawati
decisions.reason: The three colors are "zambarau" (purple), "nyekundu" (crimson) and "samawati" (blue), with "uzi" (yarn) supplied at Literal and Balanced and "vitambaa" (cloth) at Readable, as the English supplies yarn and cloth.

decisions.choice: [chỉ] (L), "chỉ" (B), "vải" (R) with the three colors
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names only the colors; the materials were dyed yarn and the cloth woven from it (m1). Vietnamese supplies the material as the English does.

decisions.choice: roxo, azul (every level); carmesim (L, B), vermelho (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the dyed yarns (m1) take the colors Exodus 26:1 and 26:31 give them in Portuguese, "roxo" and "azul". The crimson is a word found only in Chronicles, so Literal and Balanced say "carmesim", keeping it apart from the scarlet that Exodus calls "vermelho"; Readable says "vermelho", as the English Readable says "red". The same in verse 13 and 3:14.

decisions.choice: "ሐምራዊ", "ቀይ", "ሰማያዊ" [ፈትል] (Literal, Balanced), "ጨርቅ" (Readable), in the Hebrew order; to engrave is "ቅርጽ መቅረጽ"
decisions.reason: The colours of the tabernacle yarns in Exodus; Chronicles' words for purple and crimson are later forms of the same dyes, and the Amharic does not mark the difference.

decisions.choice: "пурпурная, багряная и голубая [пряжа]" (L, B); "пурпурная, красная и голубая ткань" (R)
decisions.reason: The crimson word here is not the one Exodus uses, which this translation renders "червлёная"; "багряная" keeps them apart. "Медь" for bronze, as in 1 Kings 7:14.

decisions.choice: argevan / karmil / tekhelet "紫色、深紅色、青色" (L), "紫、深紅、青" (B), "紫や赤や青" (R).
decisions.reason: karmil is a different word from the tola'at shani of Exodus (緋色), so 深紅 keeps it apart; R says red as the English.

source.text: וּֽשְׁלַֽח־לִי֩ עֲצֵ֨י אֲרָזִ֜ים בְּרוֹשִׁ֣ים וְאַלְגּוּמִּים֮ מֵֽהַלְּבָנוֹן֒ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יָדַ֔עְתִּי אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲבָדֶ֨יךָ֙ יֽוֹדְעִ֔ים לִכְר֖וֹת עֲצֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן וְהִנֵּ֥ה עֲבָדַ֖י עִם־עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And send to me timber of cedars, cypresses and algums from the Lebanon, for I know that your servants know to cut [the] timber of Lebanon; and here, my servants [will be] with your servants,

en.L: And send me timber of cedar, cypress and algum from Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut the timber of Lebanon. And see, my servants [will be] with your servants,
en.B: Send me cedar, cypress and algum logs from Lebanon too, for I know that your servants are skilled at cutting the timber of Lebanon. My servants will work with your servants,
en.R: Please also send me cedar, cypress and algum logs from the Lebanon mountains. I know that your workers are experts at cutting down trees there. My workers will work beside yours.

es.L: Y envíame madera de cedro, de ciprés y de algum del Líbano, porque yo sé que tus siervos saben cortar la madera del Líbano. Y he aquí, mis siervos [estarán] con tus siervos,
es.B: Envíame también troncos de cedro, de ciprés y de algum del Líbano, porque sé que tus siervos son expertos en cortar la madera del Líbano. Mis siervos trabajarán con tus siervos,
es.R: Te ruego que también me envíes troncos de cedro, de ciprés y de algum de los montes del Líbano. Sé que tus trabajadores son expertos en cortar árboles allí. Mis trabajadores trabajarán junto a los tuyos.

fr.L: Et envoie-moi du bois de cèdre, de cyprès et d’algoum du Liban, car je sais que tes serviteurs savent couper le bois du Liban. Et voici, mes serviteurs [seront] avec tes serviteurs,
fr.B: Envoie-moi aussi des troncs de cèdre, de cyprès et d’algoum du Liban, car je sais que tes serviteurs sont habiles à couper le bois du Liban. Mes serviteurs travailleront avec les tiens,
fr.R: Envoie-moi aussi, s’il te plaît, des troncs de cèdre, de cyprès et d’algoum des montagnes du Liban. Je sais que tes ouvriers sont des experts pour abattre les arbres là-bas. Mes ouvriers travailleront à côté des tiens.

sw.L: Tena nitumie miti ya mierezi, misunobari na msandali kutoka Lebanoni, kwa maana najua kwamba watumishi wako wanajua kukata miti ya Lebanoni. Na tazama, watumishi wangu [watakuwa] pamoja na watumishi wako,
sw.B: Nitumie pia magogo ya mierezi, misunobari na msandali kutoka Lebanoni, kwa maana najua kwamba watumishi wako ni stadi wa kukata miti ya Lebanoni. Watumishi wangu watafanya kazi pamoja na watumishi wako,
sw.R: Tafadhali nitumie pia magogo ya mierezi, misunobari na msandali kutoka milima ya Lebanoni. Najua kwamba wafanyakazi wako ni hodari wa kukata miti huko. Wafanyakazi wangu watafanya kazi pamoja na wako.

vi.L: Xin gửi cho tôi gỗ bá hương, gỗ bách và gỗ đàn hương từ Li-ban, vì tôi biết rằng các đầy tớ ông biết đốn gỗ Li-ban. Và kìa, các đầy tớ tôi [sẽ ở] với các đầy tớ ông,
vi.B: Xin ông cũng gửi cho tôi gỗ bá hương, gỗ bách và gỗ đàn hương từ Li-ban, vì tôi biết các đầy tớ của ông rất giỏi đốn gỗ Li-ban. Các đầy tớ của tôi sẽ làm việc với các đầy tớ của ông,
vi.R: Xin ông cũng gửi cho tôi gỗ bá hương, gỗ bách và gỗ đàn hương từ núi Li-ban. Tôi biết thợ của ông rất giỏi đốn cây ở đó. Thợ của tôi sẽ làm việc bên cạnh thợ của ông.

ko.L: 그리고 레바논에서 백향목과 잣나무와 백단목 재목을 제게 보내 주십시오. 왕의 종들이 레바논의 나무를 벨 줄 안다는 것을 제가 압니다. 그리고 보십시오, 제 종들이 왕의 종들과 함께 [있을 것입니다].
ko.B: 레바논에서 백향목과 잣나무와 백단목 재목도 보내 주십시오. 왕의 종들이 레바논의 나무를 잘 벤다는 것을 제가 압니다. 제 종들이 왕의 종들과 함께 일하여,
ko.R: 레바논 산에서 백향목과 잣나무와 백단목 통나무도 보내 주십시오. 왕의 일꾼들이 거기서 나무를 아주 잘 벤다는 것을 제가 압니다. 제 일꾼들도 왕의 일꾼들과 함께 일할 것입니다.

pt.L: E envie-me madeira de cedro, cipreste e algumim do Líbano, porque eu sei que os seus servos sabem cortar a madeira do Líbano. E eis que os meus servos [estarão] com os seus servos,
pt.B: Envie-me também toras de cedro, cipreste e algumim do Líbano, pois sei que os seus servos sabem cortar bem a madeira do Líbano. Os meus servos trabalharão com os seus servos,
pt.R: Por favor, mande-me também toras de cedro, cipreste e algumim das montanhas do Líbano. Sei que os seus trabalhadores são especialistas em cortar árvores ali. Os meus trabalhadores vão trabalhar junto com os seus.

am.L: ደግሞም ከሊባኖስ የዝግባ፣ የጥድና የአልጉም እንጨት ላክልኝ፤ ባሪያዎችህ የሊባኖስን እንጨት መቁረጥ እንደሚያውቁ እኔ አውቃለሁና፤ እነሆም፣ ባሪያዎቼ ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር ይሆናሉ፤
am.B: ደግሞም ከሊባኖስ የዝግባ፣ የጥድና የአልጉም ግንዶችን ላክልኝ፤ አገልጋዮችህ የሊባኖስን እንጨት በመቁረጥ የተካኑ መሆናቸውን አውቃለሁና። አገልጋዮቼ ከአገልጋዮችህ ጋር ይሠራሉ፤
am.R: እባክህ ደግሞ ከሊባኖስ ተራሮች የዝግባ፣ የጥድና የአልጉም ግንዶችን ላክልኝ። ሠራተኞችህ በዚያ ዛፎችን በመቁረጥ የተካኑ መሆናቸውን አውቃለሁ። የእኔ ሠራተኞች ከአንተ ሠራተኞች ጋር ጎን ለጎን ይሠራሉ።

hi.L: और मेरे पास लबानोन से देवदार, सनोवर और अल्गूम की लकड़ी भेजिए, क्योंकि मैं जानता हूँ कि आपके दास लबानोन की लकड़ी काटना जानते हैं। और देखिए, मेरे दास आपके दासों के साथ [रहेंगे],
hi.B: लबानोन से मेरे पास देवदार, सनोवर और अल्गूम के लट्ठे भी भेजिए, क्योंकि मैं जानता हूँ कि आपके दास लबानोन की लकड़ी काटने में निपुण हैं। मेरे दास आपके दासों के साथ काम करेंगे,
hi.R: कृपया लबानोन के पहाड़ों से मेरे पास देवदार, सनोवर और अल्गूम के लट्ठे भी भेजिए। मैं जानता हूँ कि आपके मज़दूर वहाँ पेड़ काटने में निपुण हैं। मेरे मज़दूर आपके मज़दूरों के साथ काम करेंगे।

ru.L: И пошли мне кедрового, кипарисового и алгумового дерева с Ливана, потому что я знаю, что твои рабы умеют рубить дерево Ливана. И вот, мои рабы [будут] с твоими рабами,
ru.B: Пошли мне также кедровых, кипарисовых и алгумовых брёвен с Ливана, ведь я знаю, что твои слуги умеют рубить ливанский лес. Мои слуги будут работать вместе с твоими слугами,
ru.R: Пришли мне также, пожалуйста, кедровых, кипарисовых и алгумовых брёвен с Ливанских гор. Я знаю, что твои работники хорошо умеют рубить там деревья. Мои работники будут работать вместе с твоими.

ja.L: そしてレバノンから、杉、糸杉、アルグムの木材をわたしに送ってください。あなたのしもべたちがレバノンの木材を切ることを知っているのを、わたしは知っているからです。そして、ご覧ください、わたしのしもべたちはあなたのしもべたちと共に、
ja.B: また、杉、糸杉、アルグムの丸太をレバノンから送ってください。あなたのしもべたちがレバノンの木を切るのに熟練していることを、わたしは知っています。わたしのしもべたちも、あなたのしもべたちと共に、
ja.R: また、杉と糸杉とアルグムの丸太も、レバノンの山から送ってください。あなたの働き手たちが、そこで木を切り倒すことにかけては名人だと、わたしは知っています。わたしの働き手たちも、あなたの働き手たちと一緒に働きます。

uk.L: І пошли мені дерева кедрового, кипарисового й алгумового з Лівану, бо я знаю, що твої раби вміють рубати дерево Лівану. І ось мої раби [будуть] з твоїми рабами,
uk.B: Пошли мені також кедрові, кипарисові й алгумові колоди з Лівану, бо я знаю, що твої раби вміло рубають ліванське дерево. Мої раби працюватимуть з твоїми рабами,
uk.R: Прошу, пошли мені також кедрові, кипарисові й алгумові колоди з гір Лівану. Я знаю, що твої робітники вміло рубають там дерева. Мої робітники працюватимуть поруч із твоїми.

decisions.choice: algum: a costly wood that cannot be identified with certainty
decisions.reason: This is the wood called almug in 1 Kings 10:11-12; Chronicles spells it algum here and in 9:10-11. There it is brought from Ophir by sea; here Solomon asks for it from Lebanon. Either more than one tree went by the name, or the name covered fine timber from both sources. The tree cannot be named with certainty.

decisions.choice: cypress: a tall evergreen, perhaps juniper or fir
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 5:22, the tree cannot be named with certainty; it was a strong evergreen of Lebanon used with cedar.

decisions.choice: your servants know how to cut timber
decisions.reason: In 1 Kings 5:20 Solomon says that no one among Israel knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians; Chronicles says the same thing from the other side, praising Huram's men. Both accounts have Solomon's men work beside Huram's.

decisions.choice: servants (Literal, Balanced); workers (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 5:20, Readable names these servants by the work they do.

decisions.choice: comma at the end of the verse (Literal, Balanced)
decisions.reason: The sentence goes on into verse 8, "to prepare timber for me"; Readable ends its own sentence here.

decisions.choice: "algum"
decisions.reason: The wood cannot be identified (meaning decision); the Spanish keeps the Chronicles spelling "algum", beside "almug" in 1 Kings 10:11-12.

decisions.choice: "siervos" (L, B); "trabajadores" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Spanish of 1 Kings 5:20.

decisions.choice: "algoum"
decisions.reason: The wood cannot be identified with certainty (m1), so French keeps the Hebrew name at every level, as French Kings keeps "almug" (1 Kings 10:11); "algoum" follows the spelling of Chronicles, with "ou" for the Hebrew u.

decisions.choice: msandali
decisions.reason: As the Swahili 1 Kings 10:11 (almug): the tree is not known for certain, and "msandali" (sandalwood) is one guess among several.

decisions.choice: "gỗ đàn hương" for algum
decisions.reason: The wood cannot be identified with certainty (m1); Vietnamese keeps the choice of 1 Kings 10:11-12 for the same tree (uncertain).

decisions.choice: "thợ" (R) for the servants
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 5:20, Readable names these servants by their work.

decisions.choice: "잣나무" for cypress, "백단목" for algum
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 5:22 and 10:11; algum is Chronicles' spelling of almug (m1). Both trees are uncertain.

decisions.choice: algumim
decisions.reason: The wood cannot be identified (m1), so it keeps its Hebrew name, as the English keeps "algum". Portuguese cannot write "algum", which is the everyday word for "some" ("madeira de algum" would be nonsense), so it takes the traditional Portuguese form "algumim". It is the wood 1 Kings 10:11-12 calls "almugue" in Portuguese; the two spellings are kept, as the two books spell it differently. "Cipreste" as 1 Kings 5:22.

decisions.choice: "የአልጉም እንጨት" for algum; cedar "ዝግባ", cypress "ጥድ"; the last clause keeps 1 Kings 5:20 ("ባሪያዎቼ ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር ይሆናሉ", Literal)
decisions.reason: Chronicles writes algum where Kings writes almug (the letters reversed); the name follows each book's Hebrew. The temple terms list sets cedar and cypress.

decisions.choice: "अल्गूम" (Chronicles); "सनोवर"
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the wood algum where Kings has almug (1 Kings 10:11, अल्मुग); the Hindi follows each book's form. The cypress is सनोवर, as in 1 Kings 5:22.

decisions.choice: "दास" (L, B); "मज़दूर" (R)
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 5:20, Readable names these servants by their work.

decisions.choice: "рабы" (L); "слуги" (B); "работники" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 5:20: these servants are the woodcutters, so Balanced says "слуги" and Readable names them by their work.

decisions.choice: "алгумовое дерево"
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the wood algum where Kings has almug; Russian follows the Hebrew of each book (m1).

decisions.choice: algummim "アルグム" transliterated, kept apart from the "アルムグ" of 1 Kings 10:11 as the Hebrew spells it.
decisions.reason: The wood is not identified with certainty (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: The sentence runs on with "共に、" into verse 8, as the English comma.
alternatives: end the verse with a sentence
decisions.reason: Keeps the infinitive of verse 8 attached to the two crews.

source.text: וּלְהָכִ֥ין לִ֛י עֵצִ֖ים לָרֹ֑ב כִּ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֥י בוֹנֶ֖ה גָּד֥וֹל וְהַפְלֵֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: and to prepare for me timber in abundance, for the house which I [am] building [will be] great and wonderful.

en.L: to prepare timber for me in abundance, for the house that I am building [will be] great and wonderful.
en.B: to get plenty of timber ready for me, because the house I am going to build will be great and wonderful.
en.R: Together they will prepare plenty of timber for me, because the temple I am going to build will be large and wonderful.

es.L: para prepararme madera en abundancia, porque la casa que yo edifico [será] grande y maravillosa.
es.B: para tenerme preparada mucha madera, porque la casa que voy a edificar será grande y maravillosa.
es.R: Juntos me prepararán mucha madera, porque el templo que voy a construir será grande y maravilloso.

fr.L: pour me préparer du bois en abondance, car la maison que je bâtis [sera] grande et merveilleuse.
fr.B: pour me préparer du bois en quantité, car la maison que je vais bâtir sera grande et merveilleuse.
fr.R: Ensemble, ils me prépareront beaucoup de bois, car le temple que je vais construire sera grand et magnifique.

sw.L: ili kunitayarishia miti kwa wingi, kwa maana nyumba ninayoijenga [itakuwa] kubwa na ya ajabu.
sw.B: ili kunitayarishia mbao nyingi, kwa sababu nyumba nitakayoijenga itakuwa kubwa na ya ajabu.
sw.R: Pamoja watanitayarishia mbao nyingi, kwa sababu hekalu nitakalojenga litakuwa kubwa na la ajabu.

vi.L: để chuẩn bị cho tôi gỗ thật nhiều, vì nhà mà tôi đang xây [sẽ] lớn lao và kỳ diệu.
vi.B: để chuẩn bị cho tôi thật nhiều gỗ, vì nhà tôi sắp xây sẽ lớn lao và kỳ diệu.
vi.R: Họ sẽ cùng nhau chuẩn bị thật nhiều gỗ cho tôi, vì đền thờ tôi sắp xây sẽ rất lớn và tuyệt đẹp.

ko.L: 저를 위하여 재목을 많이 준비하게 해 주십시오. 제가 지으려는 집은 크고 놀라울 것이기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 제가 쓸 재목을 넉넉히 준비할 것입니다. 제가 지으려는 집은 크고 놀라울 것이기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 그들이 함께 저를 위해 재목을 넉넉히 준비할 것입니다. 제가 지으려는 성전은 크고 놀라운 건물이 될 것이기 때문입니다.

pt.L: para me preparar madeira em abundância, porque a casa que eu estou construindo [será] grande e maravilhosa.
pt.B: para me prepararem muita madeira, porque a casa que vou construir será grande e maravilhosa.
pt.R: Juntos eles vão preparar muita madeira para mim, porque o templo que vou construir será grande e maravilhoso.

am.L: ብዙ እንጨት ያዘጋጁልኝ ዘንድ፤ የምሠራው ቤት ታላቅና አስደናቂ [ይሆናል]ና።

decisions.choice: crushed wheat, as the Hebrew reads
alternatives: wheat as food for your servants
decisions.reason: The word after "wheat" is the plural of a word that usually means blows or wounds, and is taken here as "crushed", that is, ground or beaten grain. The parallel in 1 Kings 5:25 has a similar word meaning "food", and one letter's difference would give that word here: "wheat as food for your servants". The Hebrew as it stands is followed.

decisions.choice: the payment: different from 1 Kings 5:25
decisions.reason: In 1 Kings 5:25 Solomon gives Hiram 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his royal household and twenty cors of beaten oil each year. Here Solomon promises wheat, barley, wine and oil for the woodcutters, with 20,000 baths of oil. The two accounts may describe two parts of one bargain: food for Hiram's court and rations for the men in the forest.

decisions.choice: cors and baths
decisions.reason: The cor is the largest dry measure, about 6 bushels (1 Kings 5:2). The bath is a liquid measure, a tenth of a cor (Ezekiel 45:14), about 6 gallons.

decisions.choice: the woodcutters are Huram's servants
decisions.reason: "To the hewers, to the cutters of the trees" and "for your servants" name the same men: Huram's woodcutters in Lebanon.

decisions.choice: woodsmen (Literal, Balanced)
decisions.reason: The word means hewers; with "cutters of the trees" beside it, "woodsmen" says who they were. Readable folds both into "workers who cut down the trees".

decisions.choice: ground wheat; olive oil (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says "ground" for crushed and names the olive, as 1 Kings 5:25 does at this level.

decisions.choice: "coros", "batos" (L); {{units:unos 4 400 000 litros|20 000 coros}}, {{units:unos 440 000 litros|20 000 batos}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The cor is 220 litres and the bath 22 litres, as the Kings terms note sets; Spanish converts to litres where the English converts, and Literal keeps the Hebrew measures.

records.literal_gloss: And said Huram king of Tyre in writing, and he sent to Solomon: In [the] love of Yahweh his people he has made you over them king.

en.L: And Huram king of Tyre said in a letter, and he sent [it] to Solomon, "Because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} loves {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made you king over them."
en.B: Huram king of Tyre answered in a letter that he sent to Solomon: "Because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} loves {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made you their king."
en.R: Huram, the king of Tyre, wrote a letter back to Solomon. He said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} loves {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. That is why {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made you their king."

es.L: Y dijo Huram, rey de Tiro, en un escrito que envió a Salomón: «Porque {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ama a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, te ha puesto como rey sobre ellos».
es.B: Huram, rey de Tiro, respondió en una carta que envió a Salomón: «Porque {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ama a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, te ha hecho su rey».
es.R: Huram, el rey de Tiro, le respondió a Salomón con una carta. Le dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ama a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo. Por eso te ha hecho su rey».

fr.L: Et Houram, roi de Tyr, dit par écrit, et il [l’]envoya à Salomon : « C’est parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a fait roi sur eux. »
fr.B: Houram, roi de Tyr, répondit par une lettre qu’il envoya à Salomon : « C’est parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a fait leur roi. »
fr.R: Houram, le roi de Tyr, a répondu à Salomon par une lettre. Il disait : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. C’est pour cela qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait de toi leur roi. »

sw.L: Huramu mfalme wa Tiro akasema kwa maandishi, akampelekea Sulemani, "Kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawapenda watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, amekufanya mfalme juu yao."
sw.B: Huramu mfalme wa Tiro alijibu kwa barua aliyompelekea Sulemani: "Kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawapenda watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, amekufanya mfalme wao."
sw.R: Huramu, mfalme wa Tiro, alimwandikia Sulemani barua ya kumjibu. Akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawapenda watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Ndiyo sababu amekufanya mfalme wao."

vi.L: Hu-ram vua Ty-rơ nói bằng thư, và gửi [thư] cho Sa-lô-môn: "Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu thương dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập ông làm vua trên họ."
vi.B: Hu-ram vua Ty-rơ trả lời bằng một bức thư gửi cho Sa-lô-môn: "Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu thương dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập ông làm vua của họ."
vi.R: Hu-ram, vua Ty-rơ, viết thư trả lời Sa-lô-môn. Vua nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu thương dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập ông làm vua của họ."

ko.L: 그리고 두로 왕 후람이 글로 말하여 솔로몬에게 보냈다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자기 백성을 사랑하셔서 왕을 그들 위에 왕으로 세우셨습니다."
ko.B: 두로 왕 후람은 솔로몬에게 편지를 써서 답했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자기 백성을 사랑하셔서 왕을 그들의 왕으로 세우셨습니다."
ko.R: 두로 왕 후람은 솔로몬에게 답장을 써 보냈다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 자기 백성을 사랑하십니다. 그래서 왕을 그들의 왕으로 세우셨습니다."

pt.L: E Hurão, rei de Tiro, falou por escrito e [o] enviou a Salomão: "Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ama o povo {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o fez rei sobre eles."
pt.B: Hurão, rei de Tiro, respondeu numa carta que enviou a Salomão: "Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ama o povo {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez de você o rei deles."
pt.R: Hurão, o rei de Tiro, escreveu uma carta de resposta a Salomão. Ele disse: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ama o povo {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. É por isso que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez de você o rei deles."

am.L: የጢሮስም ንጉሥ ሑራም በጽሕፈት እንዲህ አለ፤ ወደ ሰሎሞንም ላከ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕዝቡን ስለ ወደደ በእነርሱ ላይ ንጉሥ አድርጎሃል።»
am.B: የጢሮስ ንጉሥ ሑራም ለሰሎሞን በላከው ደብዳቤ እንዲህ ሲል መለሰ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕዝቡን ስለሚወድ ንጉሣቸው አድርጎሃል።»
am.R: የጢሮስ ንጉሥ ሑራም ለሰሎሞን የመልስ ደብዳቤ ጻፈ፤ እንዲህም አለ፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕዝቡን ይወዳል። ንጉሣቸው ያደረገህም ስለዚህ ነው።»

hi.L: और सूर के राजा हूराम ने एक पत्र में कहा, और [उसे] सुलैमान के पास भेजा, "क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी प्रजा से प्रेम करते हैं, उन्होंने आपको उन पर राजा बनाया है।"
hi.B: सूर के राजा हूराम ने सुलैमान को एक पत्र भेजकर उत्तर दिया: "क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी प्रजा से प्रेम करते हैं, इसलिए उन्होंने आपको उनका राजा बनाया है।"
hi.R: सूर के राजा हूराम ने सुलैमान को उत्तर में एक पत्र लिखा। उसने कहा, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपनी प्रजा से प्रेम करते हैं। इसी कारण उन्होंने आपको उनका राजा बनाया है।"

ru.L: И сказал Хурам, царь Тира, в письме, и послал [его] Соломону: «Так как {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} любит свой народ, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поставил тебя царём над ним.»
ru.B: Хурам, царь Тира, ответил письмом, которое отправил Соломону: «Так как {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} любит свой народ, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поставил тебя его царём.»
ru.R: Хурам, царь Тира, написал Соломону ответное письмо. Он написал: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} любит свой народ. Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} и сделал тебя его царём.»

ja.L: そしてティルスの王フラムは手紙で言い、[それを]ソロモンに送った。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がご自分の民を愛しておられるので、あなたを彼らの上に王とされたのです。」
ja.B: ティルスの王フラムは、ソロモンに手紙を送って答えた。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はご自分の民を愛しておられるので、あなたを彼らの王とされたのです。」
ja.R: ティルスの王フラムは、ソロモンに返事の手紙を書きました。「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の民を愛しておられます。だから、あなたを彼らの王にされたのです。」

uk.L: І сказав Хурам, цар Тиру, у листі, і послав [його] Соломонові: «Тому що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} любить свій народ, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зробив тебе царем над ними.»
uk.B: Хурам, цар Тиру, відповів листом, який послав Соломонові: «Тому що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} любить свій народ, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зробив тебе їхнім царем.»
uk.R: Хурам, цар Тиру, написав Соломонові листа у відповідь. Він сказав: «{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} любить свій народ. Ось чому {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зробив тебе їхнім царем.»

decisions.choice: in writing: a letter
decisions.reason: The word means something written, a document. Huram's reply is a written letter, as was usual between kings (2 Kings 5:5-7).

decisions.choice: in the love of Yahweh his people: because Yahweh loves his people
decisions.reason: The phrase gives the reason Solomon is king. The queen of Sheba says nearly the same (1 Kings 10:9; 2 Chronicles 9:8).

decisions.choice: a foreign king speaks of Yahweh
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 5:21, Huram speaks respectfully of Israel's God by name, in the courtesy of alliances; the words do not say that he left his own gods.

decisions.choice: quote marks close at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: Verse 11 begins again "And Huram said", so the words of this verse are closed here and verse 11 opens a new quotation from the same letter.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun on "su" only
decisions.reason: The English "he" for God is carried by the Spanish verb ending ("te ha puesto"), so only the written possessive "su" takes the span.

decisions.choice: o povo dele (with the deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: In a letter that says "você" to Solomon, "o seu povo" would first be read as Solomon's people, so Yahweh's people are "o povo dele", with the deity_pronoun span where the English has "his", as 1 Kings 5:17 in Portuguese says "o Deus dele".

source.text: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ חוּרָם֒ בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַן֩ לְדָוִ֨יד הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ בֵּ֣ן חָכָ֗ם יוֹדֵ֨עַ֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּבִינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְנֶה־בַּ֨יִת֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וּבַ֖יִת לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Huram, Blessed [be] Yahweh, [the] God of Israel, who made the heavens and the earth, who has given to David the king a son wise, knowing insight and understanding, who will build a house for Yahweh and a house for his kingdom.

en.L: And Huram said, "Blessed [be] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, who made the heavens and the earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, knowing insight and understanding, who will build a house for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and a house for his kingdom.
en.B: Huram also said, "Blessed be {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, maker of heaven and earth, who has given King David a wise son, full of insight and understanding, who will build a house for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and a royal palace for himself.
en.R: Huram also said, "Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, who made the sky and the earth! He has given King David a wise son who has good sense and understanding. This son will build a temple for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and a palace for himself as king.

es.L: Y dijo Huram: «Bendito [sea] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, que hizo los cielos y la tierra, que ha dado al rey David un hijo sabio, que conoce la prudencia y el entendimiento, que edificará una casa {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y una casa para su reino.
es.B: Huram dijo además: «Bendito sea {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, creador del cielo y de la tierra, que le ha dado al rey David un hijo sabio, lleno de prudencia y de entendimiento, que edificará una casa {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y un palacio real para sí.
es.R: Huram dijo también: «¡Alabado sea {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, que hizo el cielo y la tierra! Le ha dado al rey David un hijo sabio, que tiene buen juicio y entendimiento. Este hijo construirá un templo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y un palacio para él como rey.

fr.L: Et Houram dit : « Béni [soit] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, qui a fait les cieux et la terre, qui a donné au roi David un fils sage, connaissant le bon sens et l’intelligence, qui bâtira une maison pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et une maison pour son royaume !
fr.B: Houram dit encore : « Béni soit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, qui a fait le ciel et la terre, et qui a donné au roi David un fils sage, plein de bon sens et d’intelligence, qui va bâtir une maison pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et un palais royal pour lui-même !
fr.R: Houram a dit aussi : « Louange {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, qui a fait le ciel et la terre ! Il a donné au roi David un fils sage, qui a du bon sens et de l’intelligence. Ce fils va construire un temple pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et un palais pour lui-même en tant que roi.

sw.L: Huramu akasema, "Na abarikiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, aliyezifanya mbingu na nchi, aliyempa mfalme Daudi mwana mwenye hekima, ajuaye busara na ufahamu, atakayejenga nyumba kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na nyumba kwa ajili ya ufalme wake.
sw.B: Huramu akasema pia, "Na abarikiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, Muumba wa mbingu na nchi, aliyempa mfalme Daudi mwana mwenye hekima, aliyejaa busara na ufahamu, atakayejenga nyumba kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na ikulu ya kifalme kwa ajili yake mwenyewe.
sw.R: Huramu akasema pia, "Asifiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, aliyeumba anga na dunia! Amempa mfalme Daudi mwana mwenye hekima, aliye na akili na ufahamu. Mwana huyu atajenga hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na ikulu yake mwenyewe kama mfalme.

vi.L: Hu-ram nói: "Chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, Đấng đã dựng nên trời và đất, Đấng đã ban cho vua Đa-vít một con trai khôn ngoan, biết suy xét và hiểu biết, người sẽ xây một nhà cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và một nhà cho vương quyền mình.
vi.B: Hu-ram còn nói: "Chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, Đấng dựng nên trời và đất, Đấng đã ban cho vua Đa-vít một con trai khôn ngoan, đầy sự suy xét và hiểu biết, người sẽ xây một nhà cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và một cung điện cho chính mình.
vi.R: Hu-ram cũng nói: "Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, Đấng đã dựng nên bầu trời và mặt đất! Ngài đã ban cho vua Đa-vít một con trai khôn ngoan, biết suy xét và hiểu biết. Người con ấy sẽ xây một đền thờ cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và một cung điện cho mình làm vua.

ko.L: 그리고 후람이 말했다. "하늘과 땅을 지으신 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 송축을 받으시기를! 그분께서 다윗 왕에게 지혜롭고 분별력과 슬기를 아는 아들을 주셨습니다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위한 집과 자기 나라를 위한 집을 지을 것입니다.
ko.B: 후람은 또 말했다. "하늘과 땅을 지으신 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 송축합니다! 그분께서 다윗 왕에게 분별력과 슬기를 갖춘 지혜로운 아들을 주셨습니다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위하여 집을 짓고, 자기를 위하여 궁전을 지을 것입니다.
ko.R: 후람은 또 이렇게 말했다. "하늘과 땅을 지으신 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양합니다! 그분께서 다윗 왕에게 지혜로운 아들을 주셨습니다. 그 아들은 생각이 깊고 슬기롭습니다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 성전을 지어 드리고, 왕으로서 자기가 살 왕궁도 지을 것입니다.

pt.L: E Hurão disse: "Bendito [seja] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, que fez os céus e a terra, que deu ao rei Davi um filho sábio, que conhece a prudência e o entendimento, que construirá uma casa para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e uma casa para o seu reino.
pt.B: Hurão disse também: "Bendito seja {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, que fez o céu e a terra, e que deu ao rei Davi um filho sábio, cheio de prudência e entendimento, que construirá uma casa para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e um palácio real para si mesmo.

decisions.choice: Blessed be Yahweh who has given David a wise son: Hiram's words in 1 Kings 5:21, with more
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 5:21 has Hiram bless Yahweh "who has given to David a wise son over this great people". Chronicles adds that Yahweh is the God of Israel who made heaven and earth, that the son has insight and understanding, and that he will build a house for Yahweh and a palace for himself.

decisions.choice: knowing insight and understanding: having good sense and discernment
decisions.reason: To "know" insight is to have it. The first word means prudence or good sense (1 Samuel 25:3); the second is the discernment Solomon asked for (1 Kings 3:9-12).

decisions.choice: a house for his kingdom: a royal palace
decisions.reason: "A house for his kingship" is the king's palace, the house Solomon decided to build beside the house for Yahweh's name (1:18).

decisions.choice: Praise (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 5:21: to bless Yahweh means to praise and thank him.

decisions.choice: also said (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: These words are part of the same letter as verse 10, and "also" makes that clear. The quotation runs to the end of verse 15.

decisions.choice: "Bendito" (L, B); "Alabado" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Spanish of 1 Kings 5:21, whose blessing Huram repeats.

decisions.choice: "Hãy ca ngợi" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 5:21: to bless the LORD is to praise him, and Readable says so.

decisions.choice: "송축을 받으시기를" (L), "송축합니다" (B), "찬양합니다" (R)
decisions.reason: Huram speaks of the LORD in the polite style of his letter; the forms follow 1 Kings 5:21 with the ending fitted to a letter addressed to Solomon.

decisions.choice: Bendito seja (L, B), Louvado seja (R); prudência e entendimento (L, B), bom senso e entendimento (R)
decisions.reason: Huram's blessing keeps the words of 1 Kings 5:21 in Portuguese (m1). The two words for the son's gifts (m2) are "prudência" (good sense) and "entendimento", the word of Solomon's "coração sábio e entendido" in 1 Kings 3:12.

decisions.choice: "धन्य हों" (L, B); "की स्तुति हो" (R)
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 5:21: blessing God is praise and thanks, and Readable says स्तुति, as the English says "Praise".

decisions.choice: "Благословен ГОСПОДЬ" (L, B); "Слава ГОСПОДУ" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Hiram's words in 1 Kings 5:21.

decisions.choice: Huram-abi: a name, or "Huram my father" as a title
decisions.reason: The word data reads the two words as one name, Huram-abi. The second word means "my father", and some take the phrase as "Huram my master", "father" being a title of honor for an adviser or master craftsman (Genesis 45:8). 4:16 calls the same man "Huram his father". 1 Kings 7:13 calls him Hiram.

decisions.choice: I have sent: sent with this letter
decisions.reason: In letters the past tense is used for what the writer does as he writes: Huram is sending the craftsman now, with his reply.

decisions.choice: I am now sending you (Balanced); I am sending you (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the present tense the letter means (m2).

decisions.choice: comma at the end of the verse (Literal, Balanced)
decisions.reason: The description of the craftsman goes on in verse 13; Readable ends its sentence here.

decisions.choice: "Huram-abí"
decisions.reason: The word data reads one name (meaning decision); Spanish writes it as one hyphenated name, with the accent on the last syllable as the Hebrew "abi".

decisions.choice: "Hu-ram A-bi" as a name
decisions.reason: The words may be a name or "Huram my father" as a title (m1); Vietnamese follows the English in reading a name.

decisions.choice: "후람아비" as one name
decisions.reason: The word data reads one name (m1); Korean writes it as one word, like other compound names.

decisions.choice: Hurão-Abi
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the craftsman's name is written as one, "Hurão-Abi", at every level, as the English writes "Huram-abi" (m1), with the capital Portuguese gives the second part of a compound name ("Obede-Edom"). The same name in 4:16; the meaning note gives the other reading, "Hurão, meu pai".

decisions.choice: "Хурам-Ави", indeclinable
decisions.reason: Taken as a name, as the English does (m1), in the Hebrew form of Chronicles; 1 Kings 7:13-14 calls the same craftsman "Хирам"; it is left undeclined, with "человек по имени" at Balanced and Readable so that the case is carried by the noun.

decisions.choice: "フラム・アビ" as one name, with the reading "Huram my father" left to the footnote.
decisions.reason: The English renders it as a name; the meaning decision is uncertain.

decisions.choice: Verse 12 ends with its own sentence and verse 13 begins "彼は", where the English runs on with a comma.
